singles.wikitext:
{{Tennis events|2026|Austin Challenger|
| champ  = {{flagicon|THA}} [[Lanlana Tararudee]]
| runner = {{flagicon|CAN}} [[Bianca Andreescu]]
| score  = 6–3, 3–6, 6–3
| type   = singles doubles
}}

{{main article|2026 Austin Challenger}}

[[Renata Zarazúa]] was the defending champion,<ref>{{citeweb|url=https://www.wtatennis.com/tournaments/1161/austin-125-1/2026/|title=2026 Austin 125 Overview|publisher=WTA Tennis|accessdate=9 March 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://esto.com.mx/939290-renata-zarazua-es-campeona-del-wta-125-de-austin-tras-vencer-a-marina-starkusic/|title=¡La reina es mexicana! Renata Zarazúa se corona en el WTA 125 de Austin|publisher=Esto (in Spanish)|accessdate=10 November 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://cbsaustin.com/news/local/story/renata-zarazua-wins-inaugural-austin-125-wta-tournament-at-spanish-oaks|title=Renata Zarazúa Wins Inaugural Austin 125 WTA Tournament at Spanish Oaks|publisher=cbsaustin.com|accessdate=13 November 2025}}</ref> but lost in the second round to [[Bianca Andreescu]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://en.tennistemple.com/actu/badosa-andreescu-kessler-advance-in-aust/0wIT|title=Badosa, Andreescu, Kessler Advance in Austin; Vekic Stunned by 17-Year-Old Jones|publisher=Tennis Temple|accessdate=15 March 2026}}</ref>

[[Lanlana Tararudee]] won the title, defeating Andreescu 6–3, 3–6, 6–3 in the final.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.tennismajors.com/wta-tour-news/tararudee-stuns-andreescu-to-make-history-as-first-thai-woman-in-the-top-100-846586.html|title=Tararudee stuns Andreescu to make history as first Thai woman in the top 100|publisher=Tennis Majors|accessdate=15 March 2026}}</ref>

The '''2026 Austin 125''' was a professional women's [[tennis]] tournament  played on outdoor [[hardcourt]]s. It was the second edition of the tournament and part of the [[2026 WTA 125 tournaments]]. It took place at the ''Courtyard Racquet Club'' in [[Austin, Texas|Austin]], United States between 9 and 14 March 2026.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.wtatennis.com/tournaments/1161/austin-125-1/2026|title=Austin 125 Overview|website=wtatennis.com}}</ref><ref>{{citeweb|url=https://austin125.com/event-info/|title=Austin 125 Event Info|website=austin125.com}}</ref><ref>{{citeweb|url=https://dropshotseries.com/|title=New! Spring Austin WTA 125 Coming March 2026|website=dropshotseries.com}}</ref>
